prompt: Create a PRODUCTION PIXEL-ART SWIMMING ANIMATION STRIP of exactly THREE full-body frames, 3 columns, 1 row, same-sized cells. Wide 3:1 image. Draw three successive stages REACH, PULL, RECOVERY so a 1-2-3 loop shows muscular propulsion. Torso leans forward substantially and legs trail behind; no feet planted under upright hips. Keep the anatomy human/animal as appropriate, no backwards knees. Put full creature centered within each cell, leaving wide clear margins. Preserve large flat pixel clusters, don't add small details. NO text, cell borders, water, ripples, splashes, bubbles, ground, shadows, motion lines, detached effects or extra characters. Gold bell-helmet knight, lavender cloth and bell-topped staff. Keep staff in one hand. Torso 50 degrees forward. CELL1 free arm extends FAR FORWARD RIGHT, legs long trailing LEFT. CELL2 free hand sweeps FAR DOWN under torso, knees gathering. CELL3 free hand tucked UNDER FACE with bent elbow to left, both knees bent up beneath belly. Same empty bell-face and staff, three strongly distinct swim silhouettes. Entire figure inside its own third with ample margin; uniform scale chosen to fit the longest reach.
